testo:
Mach Fighter
Double Breaker
■ Whenever this creature attacks, choose another creature. That creature gets "Mach Fighter" and "Powered Breaker" until the end of the turn. (A creature that has "powered breaker" breaks an additional shield for each 6000 power.)
